node.statement: Under the hypotheses of node 1, put R:=U union V, t_3:=W.K3*epsilon, epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and let D_* be the universal constant fixed in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger. There is an explicit Stage-3 raw call with source B_U oplus B_V and target A_R=A_{U union V} whose literal map u_3:B_U oplus B_V->A_R is an extended D_*t_3-isomorphism, ||u_3(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_3, 0<=epsilon_R<=t_3, and 0<=t_3<=W.r_reset; moreover A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra and epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon.
